_about: Section order and headings of the source template. docParagraphs (core) and model_paragraphs/render_md (rot.py) both read this shape; a 'lines' section prints its heading and whichever of its blocks the model has ('always' prints the heading even when every block is empty). The core embeds a copy as RotCore.layouts.source; tests/core/layout_sync.test.js keeps the two identical.
